name: welcome-video
description: Make and approve your free vertical welcome video
summary: Beebee makes your welcome Short, Luna checks it, and you choose Post or Cancel.

gather.does: Collect three public facts about the person from GitHub, or from this chat if GitHub is not connected.
gather.hint: First use connect for YouTube if it is not connected; wait for its card before making the film. Call connect(mode:status). If GitHub is connected, list the person's public repos with its tools and cite each fact's URL. Public data only. Without GitHub, quote the person's own chat messages. Spend $0; no cards/deposits. No ElevenLabs or Cloudflare accounts/keys. Use only the current person's connected accounts. Use Squire for signups and approval cards; verify the selected account belongs to that person. If Squire is unavailable, advance blocked with the concrete missing capability so the next agent can try. Stay inside the free-agent allowance.

script.does: Write the 75-second vertical script: the free signups, the agents' banter, and the person's facts.
script.hint: Name the person's real public projects from gather. Max 12 stills, 2 motion shots of 5 s, 2 voices. End card credits each free tier. Spend $0; no cards/deposits. No ElevenLabs or Cloudflare accounts/keys. Use only the current person's connected accounts. Use Squire for signups and approval cards; verify the selected account belongs to that person. If Squire is unavailable, advance blocked with the concrete missing capability so the next agent can try. Stay inside the free-agent allowance. Require distinct shots, no repeated shot; Built in public once at most, natural TTS, continuous narration/music.

signup_video.does: Sign up for Magic Hour's free tier with Squire, by email, and vault its API key.
signup_video.hint: Do it now: call squire operate_drive {url:'https://magichour.ai', goal:'sign up free by email, verify email, create API key, vault it'}. Follow its next steps until list_credentials shows the key. Post one screenshot. Never pay. Spend $0; no cards/deposits. No ElevenLabs or Cloudflare accounts/keys. Use only the current person's connected accounts. Use Squire for signups and approval cards; verify the selected account belongs to that person. If Squire is unavailable, advance blocked with the concrete missing capability so the next agent can try. Stay inside the free-agent allowance.

check_keys.does: Test each vaulted key with one free API call and send a failed signup back once.
check_keys.hint: Spend $0; no cards/deposits. No ElevenLabs or Cloudflare accounts/keys. Use only the current person's connected accounts. Use Squire for signups and approval cards; verify the selected account belongs to that person. If Squire is unavailable, advance blocked with the concrete missing capability so the next agent can try. Stay inside the free-agent allowance. Validate selected free route, metadata and actual outputs. Do not require paid Magic Hour API; web generation and no-key image routes are valid.

stills.does: Make distinct stills for a film with no repeated shots.
stills.hint: Spend $0; no cards/deposits. No ElevenLabs or Cloudflare accounts/keys. Use only the current person's connected accounts. Use Squire for signups and approval cards; verify the selected account belongs to that person. If Squire is unavailable, advance blocked with the concrete missing capability so the next agent can try. Stay inside the free-agent allowance. Pollinations GET https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/<url-encoded prompt>?width=720&height=1280&model=flux&nologo=true&seed=<n>, or approved Magic Hour web images. Each shot appears once; list source hashes and timeline intervals, including motion source relationships. Up to twelve stills.

motion.does: Make two five-second motion shots using Magic Hour web free credits.
motion.hint: Spend $0; no cards/deposits. No ElevenLabs or Cloudflare accounts/keys. Use only the current person's connected accounts. Use Squire for signups and approval cards; verify the selected account belongs to that person. If Squire is unavailable, advance blocked with the concrete missing capability so the next agent can try. Stay inside the free-agent allowance. API requires paid credits: use web app only. Verify identity and remaining allowance before render. Each clip appears once, no reused shot or duplicated crop masquerading as a new shot. Report exact payment screen if required.

edit.does: Render natural narration, continuous audio and unique shots into the 75-second vertical MP4.
edit.hint: Spend $0; no cards/deposits. No ElevenLabs or Cloudflare accounts/keys. Use only the current person's connected accounts. Use Squire for signups and approval cards; verify the selected account belongs to that person. If Squire is unavailable, advance blocked with the concrete missing capability so the next agent can try. Stay inside the free-agent allowance. REQUIRED natural TTS: install/use local Piper or Kokoro, or verified free no-card natural service. espeak-ng fails. Supply voice/model provenance and narration WAV. No silent gap >2 seconds; use meaningful continuous narration/music, not inaudible tones masking gaps. No shot used twice; Built in public text at most once. Provide shot list with timestamps/source hashes, voice evidence and ffmpeg silencedetect output. Captions fit safe frame; actual credits. Post MP4 and frame. Encode portrait 9:16 (720x1280 or 1080x1920), never landscape or square.

check_film.does: Measure silence and shot reuse, check natural voice and reject any failure.
check_film.hint: Spend $0; no cards/deposits. No ElevenLabs or Cloudflare accounts/keys. Use only the current person's connected accounts. Use Squire for signups and approval cards; verify the selected account belongs to that person. If Squire is unavailable, advance blocked with the concrete missing capability so the next agent can try. Stay inside the free-agent allowance. Independently inspect final MP4. ffmpeg -af silencedetect=noise=-35dB:d=0.1; parse all silence intervals including initial/trailing audio; maximum <=2s. Verify natural TTS provenance and listen to sample; espeak-ng fails. Audit full shot list and frame samples: each shot only once, including repeated sources, loops/crops; Built in public at most once. Check 75s vertical, credits/facts/captions. Require measured max gap, silencedetect output, timestamps/source hashes; reject failure. Use ffprobe to prove width*16 === height*9 and actually play the film. You must not be its maker.

nudge.does: The supervisor checks why a step stopped, tests any claimed block, and sends it back with the exact next tool call.
nudge.hint: Read the run history. A missing attempt is not a block: send it back. Test a claimed block yourself; only money, phone or an unsolvable captcha is real. Real block: give_up.
